Lena (CS): Quick flag  AegisLabs (acct: AGS-7) dropped ~82% in embed+gen calls starting 2026-02-12. Renewal 2026-04-01. New Head of ML (Dara) joined 2/01; procurement mentioned a short pilot with AltVector. Need triage.
Marco (AM): Thanks Lena. Can you paste a tiny usage snapshot? I'll ping Dara and procurement.
Lena (CS): SQL snippet + result:
```sql
SELECT date, sum(calls) as calls FROM api_usage WHERE client_id='AGS-7' AND date >= '2026-02-05' GROUP BY date ORDER BY date;
-- 2026-02-11 calls=9,240; 2026-02-12 calls=1,610; 2026-02-13 calls=1,220
```
Lena (CS): No 401/403 surge; alerts-bot flagged retries and a small billing note.
alerts-bot: anomaly: AGS-7 calls -82% on 2026-02-12, retry rate +1.1%.
Ivy (Solutions): I'll grep logs for key events and rate-limits. If they flipped to local embeddings or paused jobs we should see it.
Priya (Onboarding): Offer: 20-min prompt parity + ops checklist. Can do Tue morning PT.
Marco (AM): Draft note to Dara: short, non-salesy: "Hi Dara  noticed traffic dip starting 2/12. If you're running a comparison with AltVector, happy to run a quick 3-query perf + token-cost check on your prompts and extend the trial two weeks to make it apples-to-apples. Also can help with key/SSO validation. No strings.  Marco"
Ivy (Solutions): Quick infra check: no alias rollouts. I see a burst of 403s from key fk_ags_ingest disabled at 2026-02-12T14:03Z — looks like an ingestion key was turned off. Posting trace: 
2026-02-12T14:03:01Z req id=aa key=fk_ags_ingest resp=403 reason=key_disabled
2026-02-12T14:03:05Z req id=ab key=fk_ags_ingest resp=403 reason=key_disabled
Lena (CS): that matches. Could be intentional during pilot or accidental. Still a renewal risk if procurement favors AltVector.
Marco (AM): Dara replied: they're pausing some pipelines during the AltVector proof-of-concept and asked for token-cost numbers on three representative prompts.
Priya (Onboarding): I'll prep a short enablement checklist and tentatively block Tue 10am PT for a session.
Ivy (Solutions): If they share three prompts, I can run a quick bench (24h) with latency, token counts, and cost estimate.
Lena (CS): Plan: 1) Marco requests prompts and confirms procurement timing. 2) Priya runs enablement (Tue 10am PT). 3) Ivy runs bench + cost table. 4) Offer 2-week trial extension and optional canary capacity for re-runs.
Marco (AM): Owners: Marco (outreach/procurement), Lena (monitoring), Ivy (bench), Priya (enablement). Logging CS ticket CS-9009 and setting renewal watch 2026-03-20.
Lena (CS): I'll keep an eye on logs and post updates. Thanks team :thumbsup:
